entry.title: dotnet/roslyn - Issues & Pull Requests - 2025-09-26
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • Analyzer API for consuming characters in embedded languages #80477
  • Unable to find method 'GetFixesAsync/8' on {no object} Deserializing Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.AddImport.AddImportOptions #80472
  • IDE0028 Collection Initialization can be simplified <-- creates uncompilable code for old collections #80471
  • support comment on local variables like js-doc for js/ts #80470

Closed

  • Empty <param name="" /> inserted for record types with trailing comma in parameter list #80473
  • Friendlier error message on an explicit implementation when the return type is wrong #60742
    Backlog
  • Compiler and IDE don't agree on the need for explicit generic arguments when inferred nullability doesn't match that required #80467
  • Pattern matching against "interface or null" #80326
    Next

PullRequests

Created

  • Update TPN with CG generated notices #80478
    Area-IDE
  • Handle untyped-collections+foreach in 'use collection expression #80475
    Area-IDE, VSCode
  • [main] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #80469
    Area-Infrastructure, VSCode
  • Unskip tests of MSBuildWorkspace with blazor and blazorwasm templates #80468
    Area-IDE, VSCode

Merged

  • Add friendlier error message on an explicit implementation when the return type is wrong #80376
    Area-Compilers, Community, Next
  • Remove unnecessary comment #80465
    Next
  • Extensions: add Name property on embedded ExtensionMarkerAttribute #80456
    Area-Compilers, Feature - Extension Everything, Next
  • Avoid implicit null checks while narrowing type for `or` patterns #80348
    Area-Compilers, Next

Updated

  • Extend `ToArray` optimization when targeting read-only collection types #80104
    Area-Compilers, Community
  • Handle some scenarios where attributes applied in local functions or lambdas within extension blocks were missing in metadata #80464
    Area-Compilers, Feature - Extension Everything
  • Extension block members do not have `this` parameter #80457
    Area-Compilers, Feature - Extension Everything
  • Disambiguate extension methods in "ambiguous call" error message when they have the same name but are from different assemblies #80453
    Area-Compilers
  • [release/dev18.0] Extensions: AssociatedExtensionImplementation on constructed symbols #80461
    Area-Compilers, Feature - Extension Everything
  • Add followup async public apis #80455
    Area-Compilers, Needs API Review, Feature - Runtime Async
  • [release/dev18.0] [Hot Reload] Fix syntax map for unmodified partial constructor #80462
  • [release/dev18.0] [Hot Reload] Invoke Created action from HotReloadException constructor #80463
  • Final mop-up for the diagnostic offset fixing and cleaning pass. #80394
    Area-Compilers
